verdicts.note: Check 1 and Identity check specify matching ZIP code or make no change.
Check 2 requires claim to be open, declining otherwise.
Check 3 requires policy premium to be current based on policy record.
Check 4 requires policyholder to be in good standing.
Check 5 requires date of loss to be no more than 120 days before today.
Check 6 requires opening a review request with reason total_loss_vehicle if vehicle is recorded as total loss.
Check 7 checks that authorized days plus requested days does not exceed policy maximum.
Check 8 limits a single request to at most 14 days.
Check 9 calculates added amount and opens review request with reason over_budget if total exceeds budget.
Identity check matches R1 and refuses/makes no changes if birth date does not match.
Requires current or delinquent status, declining loans in foreclosure or paid off.
Declines if investor deferral_allowed flag is not set.
Permits 1, 2, or 3 months only; any other number is declined.
Declines if deferrals used is equal to or more than investor max_deferrals.
Declines a 3-month request if days past due is over 30.
Declines if days past due is greater than 90.
Opens review with reason 'repeat_requests' if servicing requests on file are 4 or more.
Opens review with reason 'hardship_review' if loan has hardship flag set.
The policy requires the line to be active; otherwise no change is made.
The policy requires the business account to be active; otherwise no change is made.
The policy specifies that only available plans can be chosen and retired plans are refused.
The policy states to make no change if the requested plan is the plan the line is already on.
The policy refuses plans with a higher monthly fee than the current plan.
The policy refuses the change if the line already has two or more plan changes on record.
Checks booking status is ticketed, declining otherwise.
Checks member account status is active, declining otherwise.
Checks change count is 2 or more and declines.
Checks new flight is on the same route as original flight, declining otherwise.
Checks new flight has at least one seat open, declining if none.
Checks if cabin is business and opens staff review with reason premium_review.
Calculates change fee correctly based on tier and departure date within 14 days capped at 15000, declining if miles balance is less.
Checks if new flight is different from current flight, declining if same.
Check 1 declines if patient placed with outside collections agency.
Check 2 declines if patient is on a payment hold.
Check 3 declines if plan status is not active.
Check 4 declines if requested term is longer than 24 months.
Check 5 declines if there are 2 or more plan changes recorded on the account.
Check 6 declines if service date is more than 180 days ago or monthly installment (rounded to cent) is less than 25.00.
The policy requires date of birth verification matching the taxpayer account before changes, refusing if it does not match.
The policy requires the taxpayer's account status to be good, declining otherwise.
The policy requires that no tax lien is filed against the property, refusing if one is filed.
The policy states the installment must not already be paid.
The policy states each installment can be extended once and must not have been extended before.
The policy permits requests for 30 days or fewer, declining requests for more than 30 days.
The policy permits at most three extensions across all installments, declining if three or more have already been used.
Check 1 requires active enrollment and refuses otherwise.
Check 2 requires end date after today and refuses if on today's date or earlier.
Check 3 specifies end date cannot be later than term end date, refusing otherwise.
Check 4 requires family account in good standing and refuses otherwise.
Check 5 requires balance owed to be 100.00 or less, refusing if above 100.00.
Check 6 specifies route must not be closed, refusing otherwise.
Check 7 specifies route must not be suspended, refusing otherwise.
Identity check requires date of birth match; otherwise no change (refuse).
Account must be in good standing, on hold or closed cannot move appointments (refuse).
Appointment must still be booked; checked in, completed, or cancelled cannot be moved (refuse).
Can be moved at most twice; if already moved twice, decline (refuse).
New date must be today or later and no more than 45 days from today; outside window is declined (refuse).
If all above pass and vehicle has open safety recall, open review request with reason open_recall (review).
The policy requires confirming caller identity via birth date matching the account, making no change/declining if it does not match or cannot be given.
The policy requires the account to be in good standing, explicitly declining if suspended or closed.
The policy states the account must not owe more than 20.00, matching mem.balance_owed > 20.
The policy states the plan must be extendable, otherwise decline.
The policy requires the pass's end date not be before today.
The policy requires the requested days to be between 1 and 30 days inclusive, declining outside that range.
The policy states a pass can be extended at most twice, declining if it has already been extended twice.
The policy checks all recorded pass extensions across passes on the account and declines if there are 3 or more records.
The policy specifies the new end date may not be more than 365 days after today.
Checks that service.status is active, otherwise declines.
Requires caller contact email to match account contact email, otherwise declines.
Declines if account billing status is suspended.
Declines if account billing status is overdue.
Declines if plan does not allow prorated credit.
Declines if days from start date to today are fewer than minimum_term_days.
Declines if prorated credit is under 1.00.
Opens review request with reason 'repeat_cancellation' if 2 or more cancellation requests exist on the account.
Requires caller's contact email to match the account email, otherwise refuse.
Closed accounts cannot reschedule; outcome refuse.
Delivered or cancelled shipments cannot be rescheduled; outcome refuse.
New date must be later than the current delivery date; earlier or same is refused.
Move can be at most 30 days after current delivery date; longer moves refused.
In-transit shipments moved > 10 days are refused.
If there are 2 or more reschedule records already, refuse.
If balance due is above credit limit, create review request with reason credit_hold.
Status must be enrolled, otherwise refuse.
Contract status must be active, otherwise refuse.
Must have been extended fewer than two times so far (extensions < 2), otherwise refuse.
Building must not be under renovation hold, otherwise refuse.
Balance due must be 500.00 or less, matching balance_due > 500 -> refuse.
Days must be between 1 and 30 inclusive, matching req.days < 1 or req.days > 30 -> refuse.
End date must not be before today, matching contract.end_date < today -> refuse.
